# Harting Simkins & Ryan, LLP

> > Southern California personal injury law firm specializing in car accidents, wrongful death, and motorcycle accidents with a track record of million-dollar settlements.

Harting Simkins & Ryan, LLP (HSR Legal) is a Long Beach-based personal injury law firm led by Richard A. Harting and Gary S. Simkins, offering free consultations and contingency-fee representation across Southern California including Los Angeles County communities.
